data.name: Footy Strategy
data.detailed_description:
Football, One Turn at a Time


Footy Strategy is a turn-based tactical football game that puts you directly in control of the players on the pitch.

Instead of relying on fast reactions, you must read the field, anticipate your opponent and carefully plan each move. Position your players, create passing options, protect dangerous spaces and find a way through the opposing defence.

Every turn presents a new tactical problem.

Control the Match


Move players into space, build passing combinations and create shooting opportunities while preventing your opponent from doing the same.

A good decision can open the entire pitch. A poor position can leave your goal exposed. Success comes from understanding space, predicting the next move and adapting when your original plan falls apart.

Direct Tactical Gameplay


Footy Strategy is not a traditional football management game. You control the action directly on the pitch.

Core match mechanics include:

  • Turn-based player movement
  • Passing, ball control and shooting
  • Positioning and passing-lane management
  • Possession changes and contested balls
  • Goalkeeper and penalty-area rules
  • Tactical attacking and defending

There are no complicated formations to simulate in the background and no need for quick button combinations. The result is decided by the choices made by both managers during the match.

Create Your Club


Choose your club name and colours, take your team onto the pitch and build your identity as a manager.

Compete against other players, improve your rating and see how your club compares on the leaderboards.

Play Online or Learn at Your Own Pace


Challenge other managers in online matches where both players compete under the same turn-based rules.

New players can learn the fundamentals through the tutorial and use practice matches to experiment with movement, passing and positioning before competing online.

data.short_description: Footy Strategy is a turn-based tactical football game where positioning, passing lanes and smart use of space matter more than reflexes. Create your club, outthink opponents in focused online matches, and climb the rankings one carefully planned turn at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires an internet connection for online multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Additional Notes: Requires an internet connection for online multiplayer.
